sections.content: Spanish often expresses passive meaning with se + third-person verb. The construction focuses on the object or process rather than the person responsible: El producto se fabrica con materiales reciclados.

items.spanish: El producto se fabrica en España.
items.english: The product is manufactured in Spain.

items.spanish: La pieza se coloca en la parte superior.
items.english: The piece is placed in the upper part.

items.spanish: Los materiales se mezclan antes de empezar.
items.english: The materials are mixed before starting.

items.spanish: El dispositivo está compuesto de tres partes.
items.english: The device is made up of three parts.

sections.content: The verb agrees with the noun in plural passive-like constructions: Los materiales se mezclan.
